references.text: Parallel text in Exodus showing God's grace to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments
God reveals his character to Moses, demonstrating his faithful love to a thousand generations
Repeats the promise that God keeps his covenant and shows mercy to those who love him and keep his commandments
Nehemiah appeals to God's faithful love for those who love him and keep his commandments
God's mercy endures from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him and keep his covenant
Daniel confesses God's faithfulness and love toward those who love him and keep his commandments
Jesus says that those who love him will keep his commandments
The one who has Jesus' commandments and keeps them is the one who loves him
Love for God is shown by keeping his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome
